rule: HARD RULE (operator): no hardcoded numbers in the machine. Every numeric parameter below is os.environ-configurable (KSO_<NAME>) and its default is set by THIS study, walk-forward over the registered instance sets, real costs charged, conservative fills (exact arithmetic, no float shortcuts). Until the study runs, every receipt labels the current values PRE_STUDY_PLACEHOLDER. A default not traceable to a run of this study is a defect.

parameters.name: KSO_ALPHA
parameters.role: restart probability of the navigation walk (contract §6)

parameters.name: KSO_BACKGROUND
range: MATCHED_SEED_CARDINALITY (mean over registered random seed sets of the query's cardinality)
parameters.constraint: the M2 EXTRACT finding (12/50 one-hop request atoms below the uniform background) is the reason this is a parameter; chosen by the study, never by the outcome of one run

parameters.name: KSO_P3_SAMPLE
parameters.role: planted revocations per world in the M1 retraction checker
parameters.constraint: coverage/cost trade-off; reported, not tuned to an outcome

objective.primary: NAVIGATION_EXACT rate (the mechanic's own number: every live request atom the decision uses is surfaced by the walk) on held-out folds
secondary: translator invariance held (must be 1.0; a parameter setting that breaks it is inadmissible)
cost: steps and hyperedge visits per instance (Pareto, non-compensatory)
hub direction (i) rate (KS-T06b) as a diagnostic, not an objective
hard_gates: KS-T03/T04b/T05 invariants hold at every setting (they are parameter-free theorems; the checker runs at every setting as a no-alarm control)

protocol.walk_forward: folds ordered by instance id; fit on folds 1..k, evaluate on fold k+1; k = 1..4 per domain; the default is the setting with the best mean held-out primary objective across BOTH domains subject to the hard gates; ties broken by lower cost, then by the placeholder
protocol.seed_commitment: the fold assignment and the grid are frozen in this file; sha256 of this file is cited in the study receipt
protocol.leakage_guard: no held-out fold is read before the setting is chosen; the study script asserts the fold ordering hash
protocol.output: results/KSO_PARAMETER_STUDY_RECEIPT_V1.json with the chosen defaults, per-setting per-fold table, cost table, and the exact env-var block to export

run_after: M2b population lands (both domains needed); command: python research/orion-machine/reference/kso_parameter_study_v1.py --out research/orion-machine/results/KSO_PARAMETER_STUDY_RECEIPT_V1.json (NOT_BUILT)
authority: development splits only; sets defaults; grants no scientific, novelty or superiority authority
